title: Finite coefficient evaluation of the native ordinary tensor counit
statement: Fix a prime ell, a finite extension E of Q_ell, an open immersion j:X -> Z of schemes in universe u, ordinary coefficient sequence modules M on X and N on Z, and n >= 0. The counit of the native open-extension adjunction, evaluated at the ordinary tensor of the extension of M with N and then at coefficient level n, is an isomorphism.

source.place: Tag 0E8I, lemma-j-shriek-and-tensor; apply the ordinary projection formula after coefficient evaluation.

proof.text: Use the coefficient sequence evaluation and its canonical ring identification to transport the evaluated native adjunction and ordinary tensor to the module categories over the nth finite coefficient quotient on the pro-etale site.

Apply the localized ordinary extension/tensor projection formula of Tag 0E8I to the transported finite-level open immersion. The direct-sum generator calculation gives inverse composites, and naturality with respect to the quotient transition identifies the resulting map with the evaluated native counit.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0E8I, finite coefficient quotient projection formula.

from.place: Coefficient-level evaluation step of the localized projection-formula proof.
